B: Lateral infant foot radiograph with annotated talocalcaneal angle in congenital vertical talus article. Visual divergent talus and calcaneus consistent with widened talocalcaneal angle.

In the lateral X-rays, the talocalcaneal angle (TCA) and the talar axis first-metatarsal base angle (TAMBA) were measured (Figs. 3 and 4). These angles were measured three times: (1) before the intervention, (2) one year after the intervention, and (3) at the last follow-up after clinical and radiological correction. The position of the feet and the radiographic landmarks were used as described by Becker-Andersen and Reiniann [20].
